title: Prove a last-call obstruction for simple BIT support graphs
body:
This **scoped negative result** proves that a BIT controller with a simple two-owner support graph cannot close its diagonal Q/D targets. Each call has a coordinate rank-four D support, a nonzero native main Jordan chain, and two arbitrary helper columns. Those columns may write outside the D support. The last call must nevertheless have a diagonal restricted q matrix, which contradicts its main chain. **The complete kappa calculation does not improve.**

The [proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0d64d4d5d73f370182ada9825a611c86cfbf0049/research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction/PROOF.md), [exact result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0d64d4d5d73f370182ada9825a611c86cfbf0049/research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction/RESULT.json), and [positive control](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0d64d4d5d73f370182ada9825a611c86cfbf0049/research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction/CONTROL.json) state the claim and its boundary. The base is `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. The mandatory verifier has no external executable dependency.

The proof applies to any finite number of calls with independent commuting D symbols, one or two owners per field, and pairwise support intersections of at most one field. It permits D-only target flags. It does not cover parallel edges, fields in three calls, non-coordinate supports, dependent D symbols, paid thin calls, or a different main block. A two-call, four-parallel-edge word passes the exact endpoint and chain checks; its complete declared invoice has rank deficit 126 and is uniformly worse under the signed concave-moment preflight.

The package separately preserves [80 solver-dependent outcomes](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0d64d4d5d73f370182ada9825a611c86cfbf0049/research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction/solver-evidence/MANIFEST.json): 48 K4/K4-minus-edge order cases and 32 explicit parallel-edge cases. These are recorded Z3 outcomes without proof certificates. **The standard-library verifier checks their integrity, not their UNSAT claims.** Publication did not repeat the failed searches. Optional replay pins `z3-solver==5.3.1.0`.

Run the mandatory checks with Python 3.12 and no third-party package:

```sh
python3 -B research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction
```

Expected direct output:

```text
PASS_BIT_SIMPLE_GRAPH_OBSTRUCTION fixtures=48 diagonal_cases=3840 control=PASS solver_run=false new_kappa=false
```

Normal and optimized exact reports match. The registered Python 3.12 replay, committed-byte check, committed export check, and normal/optimized replay in a fresh Git-free export passed. The mandatory verifier checks 48 last-call fixtures, all 3,840 diagonal-chain cases, the saved word's literal group-ring product, role bases, helper updates, and complete target debit. Four controls reject a changed q coefficient, a missing target Q, a zero main chain, and use of the simple-graph lemma on parallel edges.

The model is motivated by the early-helper entrance method of [PR #5388](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5388), with its [pinned proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/568717635d8d11175a80024c9c596e16f54b1ea4/research/native-helper-query-bank/PROOF.md). The declared pricing control uses the [retained PR589/PR555 profile](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/kappa-rebuild/bit/README.md); [PR #589](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/589) and [PR #555](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/555) retain the [eumemic/Anthropic Claude source credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/e8-bit-p111-tuned/NOTICE.md) and earlier contributors. These are conceptual and invoice sources, not executable dependencies. A parallel author-side researcher supplied the complementary-word comparison and a degree-two precursor. The last-call proof, code and package have substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

No optional solver search, physical caller, ordinary-work tariff, uniform compiler, or multiplication assembly was run for publication. Hosted CI has not run at publication. The optional full-history guard is unavailable in this shallow checkout. The [next question](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0d64d4d5d73f370182ada9825a611c86cfbf0049/research/bit-simple-graph-obstruction/TASK.json) requires a literal funded word that changes an essential support hypothesis.
